name: Petrify
description: Petrify device discovery, playback handoff and listening-party relay.
overview: Runs the bundled Petrify relay with Jellyfin, with validated network and party timing settings and an optional browser health check.

versions.changelog: Relay 1.2.1: independent Voting mode keeps playback on the host while connected devices vote; explicit rejected-action errors and health capabilities. Improved plugin settings explain relay behavior and data handling, validate TCP/UDP ports and local Jellyfin URLs, configure party lead times, and offer an explicit credential-free health summary. Settings require a Jellyfin restart.
